newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports of Auckland to strengthen Bledisloe wharf.
newsitem.headline: Ports of Auckland to strengthen Bledisloe wharf.

text.p: Ports of Auckland said on Thursday it would spend about NZ$0.9 million on strengthening the Bledisloe Wharf so that a new container crane could operate on it.
The work would be done progressively, allowing use of the new crane within about two months, it said.
Chief Executive Geoff Vazey said inspections revealed that some of the construction was different from plans of the wharf and differed from other crane rail configurations in the port.
Vazey said it was not a major setback in financial terms.
The only additional cost related to the financial costs of bringing forward work which was already planned for the future, he said. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
